results.name: AGM Information
results.description: Presentations and materials shared during the Annual General Meeting (AGM).

results.name: Annual Report
results.description: Official complete annual report for a full fiscal year with audited financial performance. Not preliminary or unaudited results announcements, and not corrections or amendments to a previously published report.

results.name: Annual Report (ESEF)
results.description: Annual Report (10-K) in the standard European electronic format (ESEF).

results.name: Audit Report / Information
results.description: Standalone audit reports, applied accounting principles, and results of internal or regulatory stress tests. The code AR does not stand for Annual Report: a company's annual report or annual financial statements belong under Annual Report (10-K), even when they include the auditor's report. A credit-rating agency's report or rating action on the company or its debt is not an audit report: it belongs under Regulatory Filings.

results.name: Board/Management Information
results.description: Announcement of changes in the company's board of directors or senior management.

results.name: Call & Meeting Transcript
results.description: A recording, or the verbatim transcript of a recording, of ANY spoken investor event: earnings call, conference call, online results briefing (e.g. 业绩说明会), investor meeting or roadshow, Capital Markets Day, Investor Day, analyst briefing, AGM webcast or similar. The actual spoken dialogue, typically with speaker names and Q&A. Choose this whenever the filing IS the recording or its transcript, EVEN IF the subject matter is a presentation of strategy or results. The artifact is a recording, not a document, and it does not need to have been a telephone call. Not invitations, notices, or announcements of an upcoming event.

results.name: Capital/Financing Update
results.description: Updates on company fundraising, financing activities, or capital structure changes.

results.name: Declaration of Voting Results & Voting Rights Announcements
results.description: Official results from shareholder votes at any general meeting (AGM or EGM).

results.name: Delisting Announcement
results.description: Official notice that the company's shares will be removed from an exchange. The maturity, redemption or delisting of a bond, note or other debt security is not a delisting of the company: it belongs under Capital/Financing Update.

results.name: Director's Dealing
results.description: Report of personal share transactions by company directors and executives (insider trades).

results.name: Earnings Release
results.description: Announcement of quarterly, half-year, or full-year financial results, including preliminary or unaudited ('final') results announcements, with key highlights and sometimes summary financial statements.

results.name: Environmental & Social Information
results.description: Report detailing the company's performance on Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) factors. Also covers a mining company's standalone mineral resource and ore reserve report, published as part of its annual reporting suite.

results.name: Financial Supplement Data
results.description: Supplementary financial data provided in a detailed Excel spreadsheet format.

results.name: Fund Information / Factsheet
results.description: Factsheet or portfolio update for a fund, investment trust, or ETF that sets out the actual portfolio data - net asset value, top or largest holdings, sector and geographic allocation, performance figures, discount or premium, and gearing. Includes monthly portfolio disclosures and holdings summaries that list the holdings themselves. Not announcements that a factsheet, portfolio listing, or holdings disclosure has been published or can be viewed elsewhere.

results.name: Governance Information
results.description: Report detailing the company's internal rules, board structure, and governance practices.

results.name: Interest Rate Update/Notice
results.description: Updates on interest rate changes affecting the company's debt or financial instruments. A credit rating of the company or its debt is not an interest-rate notice: it belongs under Regulatory Filings.

results.name: Interim / Quarterly Report
results.description: Comprehensive financial report for a period shorter than a full fiscal year (e.g., half-year or quarter). Must contain actual financial statements or substantive financial data and analysis, not merely reference or certify such a report.

results.name: Investor Presentation
results.description: A written presentation DOCUMENT prepared for investors (a slide deck or similar) covering financials, strategy and market position. The artifact must be the document itself. A recording or transcript of someone PRESENTING such material is a Call Transcript, not an Investor Presentation, however closely its content matches this description.

results.name: Legal Proceedings Report
results.description: Updates on significant lawsuits, regulatory actions, or legal matters involving the company.

results.name: M&A Activity
results.description: Announcements and documents related to merger proposals or takeover bids.

results.name: Major Shareholding Notification
results.description: Notification of changes in significant share ownership levels (crossing thresholds).

results.name: Management Reports
results.description: Management's detailed explanation of financial results, business trends, and outlook.

results.name: Net Asset Value
results.description: Regular update of the Net Asset Value (NAV), primarily for investment funds.

results.name: Notice of Dividend Amount
results.description: Announcement of dividend amounts, payment dates, and details for shareholders.

results.name: Proxy Solicitation & Information Statement
results.description: Materials sent to shareholders to provide information and request votes for meetings.

results.name: Regulatory Filings
results.description: General regulatory announcements, compliance documents, officer certifications, and fallback category for miscellaneous filings that do not neatly fit into other specific categories. Also covers corrections, amendments, or revisions to previously published filings.

results.name: Remuneration Information
results.description: Report detailing compensation for top executives and directors. Covers remuneration reports, remuneration policies and incentive schemes. US proxy statements (DEF 14A, DEFA14A) are not covered by this type despite the shared code: they are classified as Proxy Solicitation & Information Statement.

results.name: Report Publication Announcement
results.description: Announcement regarding the timing, release, or publication of company reports (often stating the report is attached or available on the website). Also covers announcements inviting stakeholders to an upcoming results call, webcast, or investor presentation.

results.name: Share Issue/Capital Change
results.description: Announcement regarding new share issues, stock splits, or other capital changes.

results.name: Transaction in Own Shares
results.description: Report of the company buying back or selling its own shares (share repurchase/issuance).
